S.press.title: Iphakethe labezindaba le-Lewydo
S.press.lead: Konke okudingayo ukuze ubhale nge-Lewydo noma wenze ividiyo ngemidlalo yethu: amaqiniso, indaba yethu, ilogo namaphakethe ezindaba omdlalo ngamunye. Kukhululekile ukuwasebenzisa ekubikeleni.
S.press.fact.whoV: Isitudiyo semidlalo ye-indie esinabantu ababili esivela e-Ukraine
S.press.fact.langsV: Izilimi ezingu-{n}, kuwo wonke umdlalo nakuleli sayithi
S.studio.title: Abantu ababili, inhliziyo eyodwa
S.cp:about: I-Lewydo yisitudiyo esincane semidlalo sabantu ababili sase-Ukraine. U-Vlad ubhala ikhodi, u-Lilya uyaklama. Ndawonye senza imidlalo esithanda ukuyidlala.
S.story.brand.d: U-Vlad wayehlala eqeda izindatshana zakhe ze-[Medium](https://veldan1202.medium.com/) mayelana ne-LibGDX, i-Android ne-Kotlin ngendlela efanayo: «Love what you do» nenhliziyo eluhlaza 💚. Lelo sayini laba uphawu lwethu.
S.story.3.d: Umthuthukisi uhlangana nomklami. Isitudiyo asikazi ukuthi sikhona.
S.story.idea.d: U-Vlad usebenza Emabuthweni Ahlomile ase-Ukraine. Ngolunye usuku ekuseni uvuka endlini lapho iyunithi yakhe ihlala khona ngesikhathi somsebenzi — enomqondo we-CubePix ekhanda.
S.press.games.sub: Umdlalo ngamunye unephakethe lawo labezindaba onezithombe-skrini, i-trailer namaqiniso awo.
S.od.tag: Imizila emibili. Ukuthepha okukodwa. Konke ukugxuma kusesigqini.
S.pk.line.orbitdash: Umdlalo wesigqi emkhathini ojulile: ukuthepha okukodwa kushintsha umzila, futhi konke ukugxuma kuwela esigqini somculo wethu.
S.press.logo.title: Ilogo ye-Lewydo
S.press.logo.sub: Ama-PNG angabonisi ingemuva, aphuma ngqo emidlalweni yethu. Sicela ubeke uphawu ngemuva elimnyama ungaguquli imibala noma ubukhulu balo.
S.press.kit: **Lonke iphakethe lophawu**: imithetho, imibala, amafonti, umsindo we-Lewydo nekhodi yemidlalo yethu.
S.press.use.title: Ukusebenzisa lezi zinto
S.press.use.yes: Zisebenzise ezindabeni, ekubuyekezweni, kumavidiyo, ekusakazweni bukhoma nasezithombeni zokuxhumana mayelana ne-Lewydo nemidlalo yethu.
S.press.use.resize: Shintsha usayizi wezithombe zihambisane nesakhiwo sakho.
S.press.use.no: Ungaphinde udwebe, ungaguquli umbala noma udonse ilogo, futhi ungayisebenzisi ukukhomba ubambiswano olusemthethweni.
S.press.use.ask: Udinga okunye, njengenhlolokhono noma okwengeziwe ngomdlalo? Sibhalele:
S.press.follow.title: Landela i-Lewydo
S.press.follow.sub: Imidlalo emisha, izibuyekezo nendaba ngemuva kwazo.
